# appdynamics_email_digests (Data Source)

Lists the email digests defined for an AppDynamics business application.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "appdynamics_email_digests" "all" {
  application_id = 42
}

output "email_digest_names" {
  value = { for ed in data.appdynamics_email_digests.all.email_digests : ed.id => ed.name }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (Number) ID of the business application to list email digests for.

### Read-Only

- `email_digests` (Attributes List) The email digests defined for the application. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--email_digests))

<a id="nestedatt--email_digests"></a>
### Nested Schema for `email_digests`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `id` (String) Email digest ID.
- `name` (String)
